question: Do the 5 orphan validations (green seals whose proof no longer exists) get removed through the artifact door's remove verb, or kept?
why_it_blocks: Measured 2026-09-15 while charting 77f15efd5a96: 5 of the 31 green seals naming no tooth are ORPHANS — the proof they seal was deleted (ground_loop/test_loop_not_stale.py in 8d418170, inference_domain/test_route.py in 396da3ce, harbor_master/test_journey.py, web_server/test_journey_pane.py, diagnostic_inspector/test_interpreter.py — the last three in July/August). There is no proof to make print teeth, so D3's fix-in-the-proof cannot apply; the census invariant (D4, 0 of N) reads 5 until they are disposed. My read: an orphan green vouches for nothing and goes through artifact.remove (journaled, why = orphaned by <commit>) — not an exemption, a record about a deleted subject. But it deletes 5 records of truth, so it is yours.
answer: orphan seals - i can see no way whatsoever that we'd find them useful later. that one should be no different from the others, yes?
